title_zh: 新冠病毒 pp1a / pp1ab 多聚蛋白与主蛋白酶 Mpro 的加工
title_en: SARS-CoV-2 pp1a / pp1ab polyproteins and processing by the main protease

points.zh: SARS-CoV-2 是 RNA 病毒，入侵细胞后把自己的 genomic RNA (gRNA) 交给宿主 ribosome 直接翻译。
points.en: SARS-CoV-2 is an RNA virus; once inside the cell its genomic RNA (gRNA) is translated directly on host ribosomes.

points.zh: 翻译产物是两条 polyprotein，名字叫 pp1a 和 pp1ab；课上说 pp1a 是「全长、整个基因组完全翻译出来的」。
points.en: Translation yields two polyproteins, pp1a and pp1ab; the lecture calls pp1a the 'full-length' product translated from the whole genome.

points.zh: 课上说 pp1ab 来自一次移码：读到某个位置整个 reading frame / 密码子往前或往后移一位，产生另一条多肽。
points.en: The lecture attributes pp1ab to a frameshift: at a certain position the whole reading frame slips one base, producing a different polypeptide.

points.zh: 老师把这个移码称作一个「突变」，并说是 polymerase 读到那个位置时发生的。
points.en: The teacher calls this frameshift a 'mutation' and says the polymerase does it upon reaching that position.

points.zh: 这两条多肽非常长（课上说一两千个氨基酸），并且还没有折叠，只是长链多肽。
points.en: Both polyproteins are very long (the lecture says one to two thousand residues) and are still unfolded chains.

points.zh: 它们必须被主蛋白酶 main protease (Mpro) 做 proteolytic cleavage 才能成熟。
points.en: They must undergo proteolytic cleavage by the main protease (Mpro) before they can mature.

points.zh: 切出的产物是 nsp1 一直到 nsp 十几；NSP 老师读作 non-structured protein，意思是非结构蛋白。
points.en: Cleavage releases nsp1 through the teens; the teacher reads NSP as 'non-structured protein', meaning nonstructural protein.

points.zh: 每段 nsp 各自折叠后再组装成病毒的复制「工厂」；老师澄清 polymerase 只是其中几个部分，不是所有 nsp 都是 RdRp。
points.en: Each nsp folds on its own and they assemble into the viral replication 'factory'; the teacher clarifies that the polymerase is only a few of them, not every nsp is RdRp.

extra.zh: pp1a 与 pp1ab 的长短讲反了。核糖体读到 ORF1a 末端的终止密码子就停下，得到较短的 pp1a（约 4400 aa）；只有发生 -1 移码、读进 ORF1b 的那部分核糖体才做出更长的 pp1ab（约 7100 aa）。所以 pp1ab 才是「全长」的那条，而且因为只有一部分核糖体移码，pp1ab 的产量低于 pp1a。
extra.en: The two polyproteins are described the wrong way round. Ribosomes that stop at the ORF1a stop codon make the shorter pp1a (about 4400 aa); only the fraction that shifts -1 and reads into ORF1b makes the longer pp1ab (about 7100 aa). pp1ab is the 'full-length' one, and because only a fraction of ribosomes shift, pp1ab is made in lower amounts than pp1a.

extra.zh: 这不是 mutation，也不是 polymerase 做的。它是 -1 programmed ribosomal frameshifting (-1 PRF)：基因组上编码了一段 slippery sequence (UUUAAAC) 加下游一个 RNA pseudoknot，核糖体在此停顿并滑移一位。基因组序列本身不改变，同一条 mRNA 同时产出两种产物，比例由移码效率决定。
extra.en: This is neither a mutation nor something the polymerase does. It is -1 programmed ribosomal frameshifting (-1 PRF): the genome encodes a slippery sequence (UUUAAAC) followed by an RNA pseudoknot that stalls the ribosome and makes it slip one base. The genome sequence is unchanged; one mRNA gives both products, in a ratio set by the frameshifting efficiency.

extra.zh: Mpro 就是 nsp5，也叫 3C-like protease (3CLpro)。它的切割特征是 P1 位必须是 Gln（Leu-Gln↓Ser/Ala/Gly）；人类蛋白酶几乎没有这种专一性，所以它是理想的抗病毒靶点（nirmatrelvir，即 Paxlovid 的活性成分）。另一条病毒蛋白酶是 PLpro (nsp3)，RdRp 是 nsp12，全部共 16 个 nsp。
extra.en: Mpro is nsp5, also called the 3C-like protease (3CLpro). Its hallmark is an absolute requirement for Gln at P1 (Leu-Gln down-arrow Ser/Ala/Gly); almost no human protease has this specificity, which makes it an excellent antiviral target (nirmatrelvir, the active component of Paxlovid). The other viral protease is PLpro (nsp3), the RdRp is nsp12, and there are 16 nsps in total.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 「NSP 是 spike 前后的那个东西」不准确。nsp1-16 全部来自基因组 5' 端约三分之二的 ORF1a/ORF1ab，位于 structural genes (S, E, M, N) 的上游；spike 由单独的 subgenomic mRNA 翻译，不经 Mpro 切割。另外术语是 nonstructural protein，不是 non-structured。
extra.en: 'NSPs are the things around spike' is not accurate. nsp1-16 all come from ORF1a/ORF1ab, which occupies the 5' two-thirds of the genome upstream of the structural genes (S, E, M, N); spike is translated from its own subgenomic mRNA and is never cut by Mpro. Also the term is nonstructural protein, not non-structured.

quiz.q_zh: pp1ab 比 pp1a 长，根本原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: Why is pp1ab longer than pp1a?

options.zh: 聚合酶在复制病毒基因组时插入了一个额外核苷酸
options.en: The polymerase inserts an extra nucleotide while copying the genome

options.zh: 主蛋白酶把多聚蛋白上的某一个切割位点漏切掉了
options.en: The main protease leaves one cleavage site of the polyprotein uncut

options.zh: 病毒基因组为这两个产物提供了不同的起始密码子
options.en: The genome provides two different start codons for the two products

options.zh: 核糖体在滑移序列上 -1 移码，读进 ORF1b
options.en: The ribosome shifts -1 at a slippery site into ORF1b

quiz.explain_zh: -1 programmed ribosomal frameshifting 由 slippery sequence 加 RNA pseudoknot 触发，让核糖体越过 ORF1a 的终止密码子继续读 ORF1b，因此 pp1ab 更长。聚合酶插入核苷酸会改变基因组序列，属于真正的突变，与此无关；Mpro 的切割发生在翻译之后，只决定 nsp 的释放而不改变多肽总长；病毒 gRNA 上 ORF1a/1ab 共用同一个起始密码子。
quiz.explain_en: -1 programmed ribosomal frameshifting, driven by a slippery sequence plus an RNA pseudoknot, lets the ribosome bypass the ORF1a stop codon and continue into ORF1b, so pp1ab is longer. Nucleotide insertion by the polymerase would change the genome sequence and is a genuine mutation, unrelated here; Mpro acts after translation and only releases nsps without changing total chain length; ORF1a and ORF1ab share one start codon.

quiz.q_zh: Mpro (nsp5) 切割位点最有特征的残基要求是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the hallmark residue requirement at an Mpro (nsp5) cleavage site?

options.zh: P1' 位必须是 Asp（天冬氨酸）
options.en: Asp is required at the P1' position

options.zh: P1 位必须是 Gln（谷氨酰胺）
options.en: Gln is required at the P1 position

options.zh: P2 位必须是 Trp（色氨酸）
options.en: Trp is required at the P2 position

options.zh: P1 位必须是 Arg（精氨酸）
options.en: Arg is required at the P1 position

quiz.explain_zh: Mpro 的经典识别序列是 Leu-Gln↓(Ser/Ala/Gly)，P1 位的 Gln 是绝对要求，人源蛋白酶罕有此专一性。P1 位 Arg 是 trypsin 类丝氨酸蛋白酶的偏好；P1' 位 Asp 不是任何主要蛋白酶家族的决定因素；Trp 是大体积芳香残基，属于 chymotrypsin 类酶的 P1 偏好，不是 P2 要求。
quiz.explain_en: The canonical Mpro site is Leu-Gln down-arrow (Ser/Ala/Gly), and Gln at P1 is an absolute requirement rarely matched by human proteases. Arg at P1 is the preference of trypsin-like serine proteases; Asp at P1' is not a determinant for any major protease family; Trp is a bulky aromatic favoured at P1 by chymotrypsin-like enzymes, not required at P2.

quiz.q_zh: 关于 nsp 的下列说法，哪一项正确？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about the nsps is correct?

options.zh: 全称是 non-structured protein，指未折叠的蛋白
options.en: The name is non-structured protein, meaning an unfolded protein

options.zh: 全称是 nonstructural protein，由多聚蛋白切割产生
options.en: The name is nonstructural protein, released by polyprotein cleavage

options.zh: 由各自的亚基因组 mRNA 翻译，不需要蛋白酶切割
options.en: Each is translated from its own subgenomic mRNA without cleavage

options.zh: 每一个 nsp 都是 RdRp 复合体中的一个催化亚基
options.en: Every nsp is a catalytic subunit of the RdRp holoenzyme complex

quiz.explain_zh: NSP = nonstructural protein 非结构蛋白，指不进入病毒颗粒结构的蛋白，与折叠状态无关，全部由 pp1a/pp1ab 经 PLpro 和 Mpro 切割释放。由亚基因组 mRNA 单独翻译的是 structural 和 accessory 蛋白（S、E、M、N 等）。RdRp 只是 nsp12，其余 nsp 各有功能，如 nsp3 是 PLpro、nsp5 是 Mpro、nsp14 有校对外切酶活性。
quiz.explain_en: NSP stands for nonstructural protein, meaning proteins not incorporated into the virion, with no implication about folding; all are released from pp1a/pp1ab by PLpro and Mpro. The proteins translated from separate subgenomic mRNAs are the structural and accessory ones (S, E, M, N and others). The RdRp is only nsp12; other nsps have distinct roles, such as nsp3 as PLpro, nsp5 as Mpro and nsp14 as a proofreading exonuclease.

title_zh: FRET 荧光底物测 Mpro 酶活：底物设计、终点法读数与曲线拟合
title_en: Measuring Mpro activity with a FRET substrate: design, endpoint readout and curve fitting

points.zh: Mpro 既然是酶，就用最简单的酶活方法检测；课上用的是 FRET（荧光共振能量转移）。
points.en: Since Mpro is an enzyme, activity is measured by the simplest available assay; the lecture uses FRET (fluorescence resonance energy transfer).

points.zh: 天然底物 pp1a/pp1ab 太长（上千氨基酸），但 Mpro 的识别位点非常固定，所以可以用一段合成短肽代替。
points.en: The natural substrates pp1a/pp1ab are far too long (over a thousand residues), but Mpro's recognition site is highly fixed, so a short synthetic peptide can stand in.

points.zh: 底物设计：短肽中间放蛋白酶的酶切位点，左右两端分别接上荧光的 donor 和 acceptor。
points.en: Substrate design: the protease cleavage site sits in the middle of a short peptide, with a fluorescent donor on one end and an acceptor on the other.

points.zh: 课上对「切开／未切开哪一种发光」连说了两遍且前后相反；实测曲线呈现的是荧光信号随切割进行而上升。
points.en: The lecture states which state fluoresces twice and in contradictory ways; what the measured curves actually show is fluorescence rising as cleavage proceeds.

points.zh: 读数方式老师称为「终点法」：每隔 15 秒或 30 秒测一个时间点的荧光强度，得到荧光—时间曲线。
points.en: The readout is called the 'endpoint method': fluorescence intensity is recorded every 15 or 30 seconds, giving a fluorescence-versus-time curve.

points.zh: 实验做的是蛋白稀释梯度：稀释倍数越高，荧光信号上升得越慢，代表酶活速率越低。
points.en: The experiment is a protein dilution series: the higher the dilution, the more slowly the fluorescence rises, meaning a lower reaction rate.

points.zh: 机器在图上画两条虚线圈出它认为的线性段，自动拟合出标为 max V 的值，老师把它当作 Vmax。
points.en: The instrument draws two dashed lines around the stretch it considers linear and fits the value it labels max V, which the teacher treats as Vmax.

points.zh: 浓度高（稀释少）时很短时间内就能拟合出来，浓度低的要等更长时间才能达到可拟合的线性段。
points.en: At high enzyme concentration the fit is reached within a short time, while heavily diluted samples take much longer to give a fittable linear stretch.

points.zh: 老师总结 FRET 是目前最常用的酶活方法：成本相当低、测得迅速、可重复性很好。
points.en: The teacher concludes that FRET is currently the most widely used activity assay: very low cost, fast, and highly reproducible.

extra.zh: FRET 的方向课上说反了一次，正确的机制是：底物完整时 donor 与 acceptor 距离在 Förster 半径（约 1-10 nm）之内，donor 的激发能非辐射地转移给 acceptor，donor 自身荧光被淬灭；被切开后两个片段扩散分离，转移效率随距离的六次方倒数急剧下降，donor 荧光因此上升。所以上升的荧光强度正比于已被切开的底物量。
extra.en: The direction of FRET is stated backwards once. The correct mechanism: while the peptide is intact, donor and acceptor sit within the Forster radius (roughly 1-10 nm), the donor's excitation energy transfers non-radiatively to the acceptor and donor emission is quenched. After cleavage the two fragments diffuse apart, transfer efficiency collapses as the inverse sixth power of distance, and donor fluorescence rises. The rising signal is therefore proportional to the amount of substrate already cleaved.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 从一条进程曲线线性段拟合出来的不是 Vmax，而是该底物浓度下的初速度 v0。仪器标的 max V 指的只是这条曲线上斜率最大的一段。只有当 [S] 远大于 Km 使酶接近饱和时，v0 才逼近 Vmax；一般要在一系列不同 [S] 下各取 v0，再拟合米氏曲线外推出 Vmax。课上这个实验变的是酶的稀释度而不是 [S]，所以它比较的是不同 [E] 下的 v0，v0 与 [E] 成正比。
extra.en: What is fitted from the linear stretch of one progress curve is not Vmax but the initial velocity v0 at that substrate concentration. The instrument's 'max V' just means the steepest segment of that curve. Only when [S] is far above Km, so the enzyme is near saturation, does v0 approach Vmax; normally you take v0 at a series of different [S] values and extrapolate Vmax by fitting the Michaelis curve. The experiment shown varies enzyme dilution rather than [S], so it compares v0 at different [E], and v0 is proportional to [E].

extra.zh: 严格的终点法 (endpoint assay) 是反应到某时刻加终止液，只读一个点；课上这种每 15-30 秒连续读一遍的实际上是连续监测 (continuous / kinetic read)。两者的共同要求都是取初速度区间：底物消耗一般控制在 10% 以内，此时产物尚未抑制、酶尚未失活、逆反应可忽略，曲线才是直的。
extra.en: A strict endpoint assay quenches the reaction at one time and reads a single point; reading every 15-30 seconds as shown here is really a continuous kinetic read. Both share the same requirement of staying in the initial-velocity window, typically under about 10% substrate consumption, where product inhibition and enzyme inactivation are negligible, the reverse reaction can be ignored, and the curve is genuinely straight.

extra.zh: FRET 底物有一个实际限制：底物浓度太高时激发光和发射光被底物自身吸收，即内滤效应 (inner filter effect)，测得的速率偏低，曲线看起来像底物抑制。因此可用的 [S] 范围往往达不到 Km 的十倍以上，真正的饱和平台测不到，Vmax 只能靠拟合外推，这也是不能把仪器给的斜率直接当 Vmax 的现实原因。
extra.en: FRET substrates carry a practical limit: at high substrate concentration the substrate itself absorbs both excitation and emission light, the inner filter effect, so measured rates fall low and the curve mimics substrate inhibition. The usable [S] range therefore often fails to reach ten times Km, the true saturation plateau is never observed, and Vmax must come from an extrapolated fit, which is the practical reason the instrument's slope cannot be read as Vmax.

quiz.q_zh: FRET 底物被蛋白酶切开后，观察到的信号变化及其原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: What signal change follows protease cleavage of a FRET substrate, and why?

options.zh: donor 荧光上升，因为能量转移效率下降了
options.en: Donor fluorescence rises, because energy transfer becomes less efficient

options.zh: acceptor 荧光上升，因为两端的距离缩短了
options.en: Acceptor fluorescence rises, because the two ends are brought closer

options.zh: 两端荧光同时下降，因为荧光基团被降解
options.en: Both fluorophores dim, because the dyes are destroyed by the protease

options.zh: donor 荧光下降，因为能量转移效率升高了
options.en: Donor fluorescence falls, because energy transfer becomes more efficient

quiz.explain_zh: 切开后两个片段自由扩散，donor 与 acceptor 的距离远超 Förster 半径，转移效率按距离六次方倒数骤降，donor 不再被淬灭，荧光上升。转移效率升高只会发生在两者靠近时，与切开相反；切割使两端分离而非缩短距离；蛋白酶水解肽键，并不破坏荧光基团本身。
quiz.explain_en: After cleavage the two fragments diffuse freely, donor and acceptor separate far beyond the Forster radius, transfer efficiency collapses as the inverse sixth power of distance, the donor is no longer quenched and its emission rises. Transfer efficiency increases only when the pair comes closer, the opposite of cleavage; cleavage separates the ends rather than shortening the distance; the protease hydrolyses a peptide bond and does not destroy the dyes.

quiz.q_zh: 从单条进程曲线的前段线性斜率，直接得到的是哪个量？
quiz.q_en: What quantity does the early linear slope of a single progress curve give directly?

options.zh: 该酶对这个底物的米氏常数 Km
options.en: The Michaelis constant Km of that enzyme for the substrate

options.zh: 该反应的平衡常数 Keq
options.en: The equilibrium constant Keq of the overall reaction

options.zh: 该底物浓度下的初速度 v0
options.en: The initial velocity v0 at that substrate concentration

options.zh: 该酶在饱和条件下的最大速度 Vmax
options.en: The maximal velocity Vmax of that enzyme at saturation

quiz.explain_zh: 线性段的斜率就是该 [S] 条件下产物生成的初速度 v0。Vmax 是 [S] 趋于无穷时的渐近极限，只有在酶接近饱和时 v0 才逼近它；Km 需要在一系列 [S] 下测 v0 后拟合才能得到；Keq 由反应的自由能变决定，酶不改变它，任何速率测定都读不出它。
quiz.explain_en: The slope of the linear stretch is the initial velocity v0 at that particular [S]. Vmax is the asymptotic limit as [S] goes to infinity and is approached by v0 only near saturation; Km requires fitting v0 values measured across a series of [S]; Keq is set by the free energy change of the reaction, is unaffected by the enzyme, and cannot be read from any rate measurement.

quiz.q_zh: 稀释倍数越高，荧光信号上升越慢，正确的解释是什么？
quiz.q_en: Higher dilution makes the fluorescence rise more slowly. What is the correct explanation?

options.zh: 酶的浓度降低了，反应速率随之降低
options.en: The enzyme concentration falls, so the reaction rate falls with it

options.zh: 荧光基团的量子产率随着稀释而下降
options.en: The quantum yield of the fluorophores falls as the sample is diluted

options.zh: 底物的 Km 随着稀释倍数增大而变大
options.en: The Km for the substrate grows larger as the sample is diluted

options.zh: 酶的 Vmax 随着稀释倍数增大而升高
options.en: The Vmax of the enzyme grows larger as the sample is diluted

quiz.explain_zh: 稀释的是酶，v0 = kcat[E]t[S]/(Km+[S]) 与 [E]t 成正比，酶少了速率就低。Km 是酶与底物结合的固有性质，不随酶浓度改变；Vmax = kcat[E]t 随稀释是下降而非升高；量子产率是荧光基团本身的分子性质，与酶的稀释无关。
quiz.explain_en: It is the enzyme that is diluted, and v0 = kcat[E]t[S]/(Km+[S]) is proportional to [E]t, so less enzyme gives a lower rate. Km is an intrinsic property of enzyme-substrate binding and does not change with enzyme concentration; Vmax = kcat[E]t falls rather than rises on dilution; quantum yield is a molecular property of the dye, unrelated to how much enzyme is present.

title_zh: 课堂问答（题外话）：RdRp 的酶活怎么测，定性与定量的选择
title_en: Q&A digression: how to assay RdRp activity, and choosing between qualitative and quantitative

points.zh: 学生提问：以后自己做 RdRp，是不是也可以用刚讲的这套 FRET 方法。
points.en: A student asks whether the FRET method just described could be used for their own future work on RdRp.

points.zh: 老师回答：RdRp 的底物是 DNA 或 RNA 而不是多肽，但也有类似的荧光方法可用。
points.en: The teacher answers that RdRp uses DNA or RNA rather than a peptide as substrate, but comparable fluorescence methods exist.

points.zh: 荧光方法的好处是既可定性也可定量，老师说可以把 Vmax 测出来。
points.en: The advantage of fluorescence methods is that they serve both qualitative and quantitative purposes; the teacher says Vmax can be obtained.

points.zh: 如果只想定性，实际用得最多的是加染料然后测它的 emission。
points.en: If only a qualitative answer is needed, the most common approach in practice is to add a dye and read its emission.

points.zh: 老师说 RdRp 大概也是用染料，原理有点像 qPCR：核酸链被延长后染料结合，荧光信号随之上升。
points.en: The teacher suggests RdRp assays also use dyes on a principle similar to qPCR: as the nucleic acid chain is extended the dye binds and the signal rises.

points.zh: 另一种可能是直接用带荧光的 RNA/DNA，一延长荧光信号就上升。
points.en: An alternative he raises is using fluorescently labelled RNA or DNA whose signal increases as the chain is extended.

points.zh: 纯定性还可以跑胶：投进去 20 个 nucleotide 的底物，反应完后产物可能到四五十个 nucleotide。
points.en: For a purely qualitative answer one can run a gel: feed in a 20-nucleotide substrate and the product may reach forty or fifty nucleotides.

points.zh: 老师建议先搜商品化的酶活试剂盒，印象里 RdRp 是有现成 kit 可以直接用的。
points.en: The teacher advises searching for a commercial activity kit first, recalling that ready-made RdRp kits exist.

points.zh: 老师明确说明这一段是听说的、自己没做过 RdRp，属于需要自行核实的内容。
points.en: The teacher explicitly flags this passage as hearsay since he has never worked on RdRp, so it needs independent verification.

extra.zh: 染料法的分子基础：SYBR Green、PicoGreen 这类花菁染料嵌入双链核酸后量子产率提高上百倍，而在游离状态或单链上几乎不发光，这正是 qPCR 的原理。用在 RdRp 上，读到的是新合成双链产物的总量。要做真正的 RdRp 单步动力学，经典做法是 [alpha-32P]NTP 掺入后跑变性 PAGE，或用荧光标记引物延伸后在测序胶上分辨到单个核苷酸。
extra.en: The molecular basis of dye assays: cyanine dyes such as SYBR Green and PicoGreen increase their quantum yield roughly a hundredfold on intercalating into double-stranded nucleic acid and are nearly dark when free or on single strands, which is exactly the qPCR principle. Applied to RdRp they report the total amount of newly made duplex. Genuine single-step RdRp kinetics is classically done by incorporating [alpha-32P]NTP followed by denaturing PAGE, or by extending a fluorescently labelled primer and resolving single-nucleotide steps on a sequencing gel.

extra.zh: 「定性 vs 定量」和「终点 vs 连续」是两个独立的维度，课上把它们混在一起说了。跑胶是终点式的，能分辨产物长度但很难做时间分辨的动力学；染料法是连续式的、可定量，但完全不分辨产物长度，无法区分「一条链延长了 30 nt」和「三条链各延长 10 nt」。选方法之前要先明确自己要的是哪一个。
extra.en: Qualitative-versus-quantitative and endpoint-versus-continuous are two independent axes that the lecture blends together. A gel is an endpoint method that resolves product length but is poorly suited to time-resolved kinetics; a dye assay is continuous and quantitative but blind to product length, unable to distinguish one chain extended by 30 nt from three chains extended by 10 nt each. Decide which axis matters before choosing the method.

extra.zh: 「荧光方法可以把 Vmax 测出来」需要补一句：任何方法直接测到的都只是某一个底物浓度下的初速度 v0。Vmax 必须由一系列 [S] 下的 v0 拟合米氏方程外推得到，方法本身（荧光、放射性还是跑胶）只决定你能不能准确测 v0，不决定能不能「直接测 Vmax」。
extra.en: The claim that fluorescence methods can measure Vmax needs a qualifier: any method directly measures only the initial velocity v0 at one substrate concentration. Vmax must be extrapolated by fitting the Michaelis equation to v0 values across a series of [S]. The choice of method, whether fluorescence, radioactivity or gels, determines only how accurately v0 can be measured, not whether Vmax can be read off directly.

quiz.q_zh: 要知道 RdRp 反应产物的长度分布，最合适的方法是什么？
quiz.q_en: Which method is best suited to revealing the length distribution of RdRp products?

options.zh: 用变性 PAGE 电泳分离并显示反应产物
options.en: Separate and visualise the products by denaturing PAGE electrophoresis

options.zh: 用分光光度计测反应液的 260 nm 吸收值
options.en: Read the absorbance of the reaction mixture at 260 nm on a spectrophotometer

options.zh: 用双链结合染料连续监测荧光强度变化
options.en: Follow fluorescence continuously with a double-strand binding dye

options.zh: 用 FRET 标记的多肽底物做切割反应实验
options.en: Run a cleavage assay on a FRET-labelled short peptide substrate

quiz.explain_zh: 只有电泳能按长度把产物分开，变性胶还能消除二级结构的影响，分辨到单个核苷酸。双链染料只报告总的双链量，完全不分辨长度；FRET 多肽底物是蛋白酶的底物，RdRp 不切肽键；260 nm 吸收测的是核酸总量，聚合反应前后总核苷酸数不变，读数几乎不动。
quiz.explain_en: Only electrophoresis separates products by length, and a denaturing gel removes secondary structure so that single-nucleotide steps can be resolved. A double-strand dye reports only total duplex and is blind to length; a FRET peptide is a protease substrate and RdRp does not cleave peptide bonds; absorbance at 260 nm reports total nucleic acid, which barely changes since polymerisation does not alter the number of nucleotides.

quiz.q_zh: SYBR Green 一类染料之所以能报告核酸合成，是因为什么？
quiz.q_en: Why can a dye such as SYBR Green report nucleic acid synthesis?

options.zh: 它结合到双链核酸上以后荧光大幅增强
options.en: Its fluorescence increases sharply once it binds double-stranded nucleic acid

options.zh: 它与游离的 NTP 结合以后才能发出荧光
options.en: It becomes fluorescent only after it binds the free NTP substrate pool

options.zh: 它被聚合酶共价连接到新生的产物链上
options.en: It is covalently attached to the nascent product chain by the polymerase

options.zh: 它在单链上的荧光远强于在双链上的荧光
options.en: Its fluorescence on single strands is far stronger than on double strands

quiz.explain_zh: 这类花菁染料嵌入双链后转动受限、量子产率提高上百倍，双链越多信号越强。它与游离 NTP 结合并不产生这种增强；染料是非共价嵌入，聚合酶不会把它接到链上；它在单链上的荧光远弱于双链，方向正好相反，否则 qPCR 就无法工作。
quiz.explain_en: Cyanine dyes of this type become rotationally restricted on intercalating into duplex and their quantum yield rises roughly a hundredfold, so more duplex gives more signal. Binding free NTPs produces no such enhancement; the dye intercalates non-covalently and is never attached by the polymerase; its emission on single strands is far weaker than on duplex, the opposite of the stated direction, otherwise qPCR could not work.

title_zh: 酶动力学曲线的三段：一级反应、混合级与零级反应达到 Vmax
title_en: The three regions of the kinetic curve: first order, mixed order, and zero order at Vmax

points.zh: 先一句带过核酶 ribozyme：本质是 RNA 却能发挥催化活性（课上说的是「蛋白酶的活性」）；抗体酶跳过不讲。
points.en: Ribozymes are mentioned in passing as RNA that nevertheless has catalytic activity (the lecture says 'protease activity'); abzymes are skipped.

points.zh: 米氏方程回顾图的横坐标是底物浓度 [S]；老师说它和前面的时间进程图很像，因为随时间推移底物在逐渐减少。
points.en: The Michaelis curve is plotted against substrate concentration [S]; the teacher says it resembles the earlier time-course plot because substrate falls as time goes on.

points.zh: 反应最开始呈现一级反应特征：v 与 [S] 成正比，形式是 y = kx，x 的幂次是一次幂，因此是线性关系。
points.en: The reaction starts out first order: v is proportional to [S], of the form y = kx, where the exponent on x is one, hence a linear relationship.

points.zh: 老师这里先说成「底物远远大于酶」，随即自己当场纠正：「不对不对这个反了，是在底物很小的时候」。
points.en: The teacher first says 'substrate far exceeds enzyme', then immediately corrects himself on the spot: 'no, that's backwards, it's when substrate is low'.

points.zh: 低 [S] 段的速率主要由酶的数量决定，此时 V 不是常数而是一个变量，随 [S] 增加而增加。
points.en: In the low-[S] region the rate is set mainly by the amount of enzyme, and V is not a constant but a variable that grows with [S].

points.zh: 继续升高底物浓度，反应渐渐进入一个混合级区，即 0 级和 1 级之间的过渡。
points.en: As substrate rises further the reaction passes through a mixed-order region between zero order and first order.

points.zh: 老师说底物浓度「远远高于酶的浓度」时达到 Vmax，此时是零级反应：y = 常数 k，不再受其他因素影响。
points.en: The teacher says Vmax is reached when substrate concentration is far above enzyme concentration, giving zero-order behaviour: y equals a constant k, no longer affected by anything else.

points.zh: 因此表示一个酶的活性通常就用 Vmax，因为在那个区间速率是一个稳定的常数。
points.en: Enzyme activity is therefore normally reported as Vmax, because in that region the rate is a stable constant.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 一级区与零级区的分界由 [S] 相对于 Km 决定，不是「底物多于酶」。[S] << Km 时 v ≈ (Vmax/Km)[S]，对底物一级；[S] >> Km 时 v → Vmax，对底物零级。任何正常的酶反应里 [S] 本来就远大于 [E]（这正是米氏推导的前提之一，典型相差三到六个数量级），但只要 [S] 还没到 Km 的量级，反应照样停在一级区。判据是比值 [S]/Km，不是 [S]/[E]。
extra.en: The boundary between the first-order and zero-order regions is set by [S] relative to Km, not by substrate outnumbering enzyme. When [S] << Km, v is approximately (Vmax/Km)[S] and first order in substrate; when [S] >> Km, v approaches Vmax and is zero order. In any normal enzyme assay [S] already far exceeds [E] (that is one of the derivation's assumptions, typically three to six orders of magnitude), yet the reaction stays first order as long as [S] has not reached the scale of Km. The criterion is the ratio [S]/Km, not [S]/[E].

extra.zh: 把数字放进 v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S]) 就清楚了：[S] = Km 时 v = 1/2 Vmax；[S] = 10 Km 时 v ≈ 0.91 Vmax；要达到 0.99 Vmax 需要 [S] = 99 Km。曲线是一条渐近线，Vmax 严格来说永远测不到，只能外推。这就是为什么实验上宁可用 Lineweaver-Burk 之类的线性化作图或非线性拟合，而不是「一直加底物直到读数不动」。
extra.en: Putting numbers into v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S]) makes it clear: at [S] = Km, v is half Vmax; at [S] = 10 Km, v is about 0.91 Vmax; reaching 0.99 Vmax needs [S] = 99 Km. The curve is an asymptote, so Vmax can never strictly be measured, only extrapolated. That is why one uses a linearising plot such as Lineweaver-Burk or a non-linear fit rather than piling on substrate until the reading stops moving.

extra.zh: 低 [S] 段那条直线的斜率是 Vmax/Km，也就是 (kcat/Km)[E]t。kcat/Km 称为特异性常数或催化效率，是比较两种底物、两种酶最有意义的单一参数，它的物理上限由扩散控制决定，约 10^8 到 10^9 M^-1 s^-1；达到这个上限的酶（carbonic anhydrase、triosephosphate isomerase）被称为 catalytically perfect。
extra.en: The slope of the straight line in the low-[S] region is Vmax/Km, that is (kcat/Km)[E]t. The ratio kcat/Km, called the specificity constant or catalytic efficiency, is the single most meaningful parameter for comparing two substrates or two enzymes, and its physical ceiling is set by diffusion at roughly 10^8 to 10^9 M^-1 s^-1; enzymes that reach it, such as carbonic anhydrase and triosephosphate isomerase, are described as catalytically perfect.

extra.zh: 这里的「级数」是表观级数 (pseudo-order)，不是反应机制变了。同一个酶促反应对底物的表观级数从 1 连续变到 0，唯一的原因是酶的活性位点被逐渐占满（饱和），机制自始至终都是 E + S ⇌ ES → E + P。所以不存在「三个阶段用三个方程」的问题，一条米氏方程覆盖全程。
extra.en: The word 'order' here means apparent or pseudo-order, not a change of mechanism. The apparent order in substrate slides continuously from one to zero for one and the same reaction, purely because the active sites become progressively occupied, while the mechanism stays E + S in equilibrium with ES going to E + P throughout. There is therefore no question of three phases needing three equations; one Michaelis equation covers the whole range.

quiz.q_zh: 判断一个酶促反应已经进入零级（饱和）区，正确的判据是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the correct criterion for an enzyme reaction having entered the zero-order (saturated) region?

options.zh: 底物浓度远远高于 Km 的数值大小
options.en: The substrate concentration is far above the value of Km

options.zh: 底物浓度远远高于酶的总浓度 [E]t
options.en: The substrate concentration is far above the total enzyme concentration

options.zh: 酶的总浓度远远高于底物的浓度 [S]
options.en: The total enzyme concentration is far above the substrate concentration

options.zh: 底物浓度正好等于 Km 的数值大小
options.en: The substrate concentration sits right at the value of Km

quiz.explain_zh: 饱和的含义是绝大部分酶都以 ES 形式存在，条件是 [S] >> Km，此时 v → Vmax。[S] >> [E]t 在任何常规酶实验里都成立，也是米氏推导的前提，但它完全不保证饱和——[S] 可以远大于 [E] 却仍远小于 Km，那时反应是一级的。[E] >> [S] 会破坏推导前提；[S] = Km 时速率只有 1/2 Vmax，正处在曲线弯曲最厉害的地方。
quiz.explain_en: Saturation means nearly all enzyme exists as ES, which requires [S] >> Km, and then v approaches Vmax. The condition [S] >> [E]t holds in essentially every routine assay and is one of the derivation's assumptions, but it guarantees nothing about saturation: [S] can be far above [E] and still far below Km, in which case the reaction is first order. Having [E] >> [S] would break the derivation; and at [S] = Km the rate is only half Vmax, right in the most curved part of the plot.

quiz.q_zh: 在 [S] 远小于 Km 的区段，米氏方程近似成什么形式？
quiz.q_en: What does the Michaelis equation reduce to in the region where [S] is far below Km?

options.zh: v ≈ (Km/Vmax)[S]，与底物成正比，属一级
options.en: v is about (Km/Vmax)[S], proportional to substrate, so first order

options.zh: v ≈ Vmax[S]²/Km²，与底物平方成正比，属二级
options.en: v is about Vmax[S]²/Km², proportional to substrate squared, so second order

options.zh: v ≈ Vmax，与底物浓度无关，属零级
options.en: v is about Vmax, independent of substrate, so zero order

options.zh: v ≈ (Vmax/Km)[S]，与底物成正比，属一级
options.en: v is about (Vmax/Km)[S], proportional to substrate, so first order

quiz.explain_zh: [S] << Km 时分母 Km + [S] ≈ Km，于是 v ≈ (Vmax/Km)[S]，斜率 Vmax/Km 就是催化效率。v ≈ Vmax 是另一端 [S] >> Km 的极限；(Km/Vmax)[S] 把比值倒过来了，量纲和数值都不对；米氏机制中一分子底物结合一个活性位点，不会给出对底物的二级依赖。
quiz.explain_en: When [S] << Km the denominator Km + [S] is approximately Km, giving v = (Vmax/Km)[S], whose slope Vmax/Km is the catalytic efficiency. The form v = Vmax is the opposite limit where [S] >> Km; (Km/Vmax)[S] inverts the ratio and is wrong in both units and magnitude; and since one substrate molecule binds one active site, the Michaelis mechanism never gives second-order dependence on substrate.

quiz.q_zh: 当底物浓度恰好等于 Km 时，反应速率 v 等于多少？
quiz.q_en: When the substrate concentration equals Km exactly, what is the reaction velocity v?

options.zh: Vmax 的两倍大
options.en: Twice the value of Vmax

options.zh: Vmax 的四分之一
options.en: One quarter of Vmax

options.zh: Vmax 的二分之一
options.en: One half of Vmax

options.zh: 恰好等于 Vmax
options.en: Exactly equal to Vmax

quiz.explain_zh: 代入 v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S])，令 [S] = Km 得 v = Vmax·Km/(2Km) = 1/2 Vmax，这正是 Km 的操作性定义。四分之一 Vmax 对应 [S] = Km/3；v 等于 Vmax 需要 [S] 趋于无穷；速率不可能超过 Vmax，因为 Vmax 是这条曲线的上渐近线。
quiz.explain_en: Substituting [S] = Km into v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S]) gives v = Vmax·Km/(2Km) = half Vmax, which is the operational definition of Km. A quarter of Vmax corresponds to [S] = Km/3; v equals Vmax only as [S] goes to infinity; and the rate can never exceed Vmax because Vmax is the upper asymptote of the curve.

title_zh: 课堂讨论：米氏方程的用途，以及「Vmax 是它成立的前提」这个说法
title_en: Class discussion: what the Michaelis equation is for, and the claim that Vmax is its precondition

points.zh: 学生问：米氏方程分三个阶段，是不是每个阶段用的方程都不一样？老师回答不是，它只有一个通式。
points.en: A student asks whether each of the three phases needs its own equation; the teacher answers no, there is a single general form.

points.zh: 老师说米氏方程提出来就是为了描述 Vmax，默认这个酶已经达到 Vmax。
points.en: The teacher says the Michaelis equation was proposed to describe Vmax, assuming by default that the enzyme has already reached Vmax.

points.zh: 用法是：测定到 Vmax 之后，可以用这个通式倒推它在任意时刻、任意底物浓度下的速度。
points.en: The stated use: once Vmax is measured, the general form lets you back-calculate the velocity at any time and any substrate concentration.

points.zh: 老师提醒它是在上节课讲的几个前提假设下才成立的，但广义上可以应用于整个反应的任意位置。
points.en: He reminds the class that it holds only under the assumptions covered last time, though broadly it can be applied anywhere along the reaction.

points.zh: 实际动机：底物浓度很低时酶活速率一直在变，直接测很困难；米氏方程里有底物浓度这一项，可以倒推该时刻的速度。
points.en: The practical motive: at low substrate concentration the rate keeps changing and is hard to measure directly, but the equation contains a substrate concentration term and can back out the rate at that moment.

points.zh: 学生复述并被老师确认：实验只能测到 Vmax，阶段一、阶段二的速率是在 Vmax 基础上算出来的。
points.en: The student's paraphrase, confirmed by the teacher: experiment can only measure Vmax, and the rates in phases one and two are calculated on top of it.

points.zh: 老师明确表态：「VMAX 是米氏方程成立的前提」，必须先测定到 Vmax。
points.en: The teacher states explicitly that Vmax is the precondition for the Michaelis equation to hold, and must be measured first.

points.zh: 老师确认 Vmax 是一个常数，与零级反应 y = k 一致：固定条件下同一种酶只有一个 Vmax，不同的酶有不同的 Vmax。
points.en: He confirms Vmax is a constant, consistent with the zero-order form y = k: under fixed conditions one enzyme has exactly one Vmax, and different enzymes have different values.

points.zh: 老师说 Vmax「只跟酶的种类有关系」，代表这个酶在固定条件下催化能力的上限。
points.en: He says Vmax depends only on the kind of enzyme, representing the ceiling of its catalytic capacity under fixed conditions.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 米氏方程不是「以 Vmax 为前提」推出来的，也不假定酶已经饱和。从 E + S ⇌ ES → E + P 加稳态假设直接推出 v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S])，其中 Vmax = kcat[E]t 是方程里的一个参数，它的物理含义是 [S] 趋于无穷时的渐近极限，是推导的产物而不是前提。实验流程也正好相反：在多个 [S] 下各测一个初速度 v0，再拟合出 Vmax 和 Km 这两个参数。
extra.en: The Michaelis equation is not derived by presupposing Vmax, nor does it assume the enzyme is saturated. Starting from E + S in equilibrium with ES going to E + P plus the steady-state assumption, one obtains v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S]) directly, in which Vmax = kcat[E]t is a parameter whose meaning is the asymptotic limit as [S] goes to infinity, an output of the derivation rather than an input. The experimental workflow runs the other way too: measure one initial velocity v0 at each of several [S] values, then fit both Vmax and Km.

extra.zh: 这里有两张容易混为一谈的图。进程曲线是 [产物]-时间，画的是同一个反应随时间底物被耗尽；米氏曲线是 v-[S]，每个点都是一个独立反应在不同起始 [S] 下取的初速度。课上说两者「差不多」，只有在取初速度（底物消耗 <10%）时它们才能对应起来——正因为如此，进程曲线的后半段弯曲是底物耗尽，与米氏曲线的饱和弯曲原因完全不同。
extra.en: Two plots are easily conflated here. The progress curve plots product against time for a single reaction as its substrate is consumed; the Michaelis curve plots v against [S], where every point is a separate reaction sampled at its initial velocity from a different starting [S]. The lecture calls them 'about the same', but they correspond only within the initial-velocity window (under about 10% substrate consumption). The late curvature of a progress curve is substrate depletion, a completely different cause from the saturation curvature of the Michaelis plot.

extra.zh: Vmax = kcat·[E]t，所以它不是酶的固有常数：把酶稀释一半，Vmax 就减半，课上稀释梯度实验本身就演示了这一点。真正只取决于酶的种类和反应条件的是转换数 kcat（= Vmax/[E]t，单位 s^-1）和 Km。所以「Vmax 只跟酶的种类有关」必须补上「在酶浓度固定的前提下」；报告酶学参数时应报 kcat 和 Km，而不是随酶量变化的 Vmax。
extra.en: Vmax = kcat·[E]t, so it is not an intrinsic constant of the enzyme: halve the enzyme and Vmax halves, which the dilution series in this very lecture demonstrates. What truly depends only on the identity of the enzyme and the conditions is the turnover number kcat (= Vmax/[E]t, in s^-1) together with Km. The statement that Vmax depends only on the kind of enzyme therefore needs 'at a fixed enzyme concentration' attached, and published kinetic parameters should be kcat and Km rather than an enzyme-amount-dependent Vmax.

extra.zh: 如果实际上够不到饱和（FRET 底物因内滤效应常如此），不必先拿到 Vmax 也能描述低底物区：直接用一级近似 v = (kcat/Km)[E]t[S]，斜率 kcat/Km 可以单独从低 [S] 区测出来。这也是为什么很多抑制剂筛选就在 [S] ≈ Km 处进行——那里对 Km 和 Vmax 两种变化都最敏感。
extra.en: If saturation is unreachable in practice, which is common for FRET substrates because of the inner filter effect, the low-substrate region can still be described without ever obtaining Vmax: use the first-order approximation v = (kcat/Km)[E]t[S], whose slope kcat/Km is measurable from the low-[S] region alone. This is also why inhibitor screens are often run at [S] near Km, the point of greatest sensitivity to changes in either Km or Vmax.

quiz.q_zh: 关于 Vmax 与米氏方程的关系，下列哪一项正确？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about the relationship between Vmax and the Michaelis equation is correct?

options.zh: Vmax 可以在 [S] = Km 处从曲线上直接读出
options.en: Vmax can be read straight off the curve at the point where [S] = Km

options.zh: Vmax 是酶的固有常数，与酶的浓度无关
options.en: Vmax is an intrinsic constant of the enzyme, independent of its amount

options.zh: Vmax 必须先被直接测出，米氏方程才能成立
options.en: Vmax must be measured directly before the equation can hold

options.zh: Vmax 是由一系列初速度拟合外推出来的参数
options.en: Vmax is a parameter extrapolated from a series of fitted initial rates

quiz.explain_zh: 推导从机制和稳态假设出发，Vmax 作为参数出现在结果里；实验上在多个 [S] 下测 v0 再拟合外推。所以它是产物不是前提，也不需要先测出来。[S] = Km 处读到的是 1/2 Vmax 而不是 Vmax。Vmax = kcat[E]t 与酶浓度成正比，稀释一半就减半，真正与酶浓度无关的是 kcat 和 Km。
quiz.explain_en: The derivation starts from the mechanism plus the steady-state assumption and Vmax appears as a parameter in the result; experimentally one measures v0 at several [S] and extrapolates by fitting. It is thus an output rather than a precondition, and need not be measured first. At [S] = Km the curve gives half Vmax, not Vmax. Since Vmax = kcat[E]t it is proportional to enzyme concentration and halves on dilution; the quantities independent of enzyme amount are kcat and Km.

quiz.q_zh: 把酶液稀释一倍（酶量减半），下列哪个量会随之改变？
quiz.q_en: If the enzyme is diluted twofold, which quantity changes as a result?

options.zh: 转换数 kcat 减半
options.en: The turnover number kcat is halved

options.zh: 最大速度 Vmax 减半
options.en: The maximal velocity Vmax is halved

options.zh: 催化效率 kcat/Km 减半
options.en: The catalytic efficiency kcat/Km is halved

options.zh: 米氏常数 Km 减半
options.en: The Michaelis constant Km is halved

quiz.explain_zh: Vmax = kcat[E]t 与酶的总量成正比，酶减半 Vmax 就减半。Km 反映的是酶与底物结合和解离的速率常数组合，是单分子层面的性质；kcat 是单位时间单个活性位点的转换次数，同样是每分子的性质；kcat/Km 由这两者组成，也与酶量无关。
quiz.explain_en: Vmax = kcat[E]t is proportional to total enzyme, so halving the enzyme halves Vmax. Km reflects a combination of binding and dissociation rate constants and is a per-molecule property; kcat is the number of turnovers per active site per unit time, likewise per-molecule; kcat/Km is built from those two and is equally independent of how much enzyme is present.

quiz.q_zh: 米氏曲线上所说的「三个阶段」指的是什么？
quiz.q_en: What do the 'three phases' of the Michaelis curve actually refer to?

options.zh: 三个依次发生的、独立的化学反应步骤
options.en: Three separate chemical reaction steps occurring one after another

options.zh: 三种不同的酶各自适用的底物浓度区间
options.en: Three different enzymes each working in its own concentration range

options.zh: 必须用三个不同方程分别描述的三个过程
options.en: Three processes that each require a separate equation to describe

options.zh: 同一条曲线上的一级、混合级与零级三段
options.en: Three regions of one curve: first, mixed and zero order

quiz.explain_zh: 三段只是同一条 v-[S] 曲线在不同 [S] 下的表观级数不同，机制自始至终都是 E + S ⇌ ES → E + P，一条米氏方程覆盖全程。它们不是先后发生的化学步骤，也与酶的种类无关；正因为一个方程就够，才不需要三个不同的方程，这正是学生提问时老师否定的那个想法。
quiz.explain_en: The three regions are simply different apparent orders of the same v-versus-[S] curve at different [S]; the mechanism remains E + S in equilibrium with ES going to E + P throughout, and one Michaelis equation covers all of it. They are not sequential chemical steps and have nothing to do with different enzymes; and because one equation suffices, three separate equations are unnecessary, which is exactly the idea the teacher rejects when the student raises it.

title_zh: 米氏方程推导：两步机制与三个假设（不可逆、ES 稳态、底物远大于酶）
title_en: Deriving the Michaelis equation: the two-step mechanism and its three assumptions

points.zh: 老师说推导的具体过程不用关心，大概了解它的几个假设就够了，但要对推法有一点印象。
points.en: The teacher says the algebra of the derivation need not be followed in detail; knowing the assumptions is enough, with some feel for how it goes.

points.zh: 第一步：假定任意一个酶促反应都分两步走，先是底物加酶形成酶-底物复合体 ES。
points.en: Step one: any enzyme reaction is assumed to proceed in two steps, beginning with substrate plus enzyme forming the enzyme-substrate complex ES.

points.zh: 第二步：这个复合体再进一步释放出酶，因为酶在反应前后形状和性质都不改变，可以重复使用。
points.en: Step two: the complex then releases the enzyme, which is unchanged in shape and properties before and after the reaction and can be reused.

points.zh: 假设一：E + P 回到 E + S 这个逆反应的速率基本可以忽略，即认为酶催化的反应不可逆（老师称之为忽略那个 K4）。
points.en: Assumption one: the reverse step from E + P back to E + S is negligible, so the catalysed reaction is treated as irreversible (the teacher calls it dropping that K4).

points.zh: 假设二：ES 复合体的形成速率与消失速率完全相同，达到稳态 steady state。
points.en: Assumption two: the ES complex forms and disappears at exactly the same rate, reaching a steady state.

points.zh: 学生用「有点像氢键随时断裂随时形成」来理解稳态，老师确认这个比喻。
points.en: The student pictures the steady state as 'like hydrogen bonds constantly breaking and re-forming', which the teacher accepts.

points.zh: 老师把稳态进一步解释为「整个酶活催化的反应都达到稳态了」，学生接一句「就是平衡了」，老师应了。
points.en: The teacher extends the steady state to 'the whole catalysed reaction has reached steady state'; the student adds 'so it is at equilibrium', and the teacher agrees.

points.zh: 假设三：推导时底物浓度远远大于酶的浓度；老师由此说「这时候测出来的就是 Vmax」。
points.en: Assumption three: the derivation takes substrate concentration far above enzyme concentration, from which the teacher concludes that what is measured then is Vmax.

points.zh: 老师承认用它代换去推未达 Vmax 时的速度「不一定准」，因为还涉及很多其他因素。
points.en: He concedes that using it to back-calculate rates short of Vmax is 'not necessarily accurate', since many other factors are involved.

extra.zh: 讲两步机制时说 ES「又进一步的释放出酶和底物」，紧接着讲假设二时又说「它产生这个底物」。第二步释放的是酶和产物 E + P，这才是催化步 k2。ES 退回 E + S 走的是解离步 k-1，它确实存在，也被稳态假设一并算进去了，但不是催化步。把两者说成同一件事会让 Km = (k-1 + k2)/k1 里的两项失去区分。
extra.en: While describing the two-step mechanism the lecture says ES 'further releases enzyme and substrate', and then, introducing the second assumption, 'it produces the substrate'. What the second step releases is enzyme plus product, E + P, and that is the catalytic step k2. Reverting from ES to E + S is the dissociation step k-1, which does exist and is included in the steady-state balance, but it is not the catalytic step. Merging the two erases the distinction between the two terms in Km = (k-1 + k2)/k1.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 假设三 [S]0 >> [E]0 的真正作用，是让游离底物浓度约等于加入的总底物浓度——因为被 ES 结合掉的那一部分可以忽略，否则推导里 [S] 就必须写成 [S]0 - [ES]，方程不再是简单形式。它跟「这时测的就是 Vmax」没有关系。是否饱和取决于 [S] 与 Km 的比值：[S] 可以远大于 [E] 而仍远小于 Km，那时反应处在一级区，离 Vmax 很远。
extra.en: The real job of assumption three, [S]0 >> [E]0, is to make free substrate concentration equal the total added substrate, because the fraction tied up in ES becomes negligible; otherwise [S] would have to be written [S]0 minus [ES] and the equation would lose its simple form. It has nothing to do with what is measured being Vmax. Saturation depends on [S] relative to Km: [S] can be far above [E] while still far below Km, in which case the reaction is in the first-order region, nowhere near Vmax.

extra.zh: 还有一个课上没有点名的假设：只取初速度 (initial velocity)，即只看底物消耗 5-10% 以内、产物尚未积累的时段。这正是假设一「逆反应可忽略」在实验上的保证——不是因为酶催化的反应本身不可逆（酶不改变 Keq，正逆两个方向它都催化），而是因为一开始 [P] ≈ 0，逆向通量自然为零。
extra.en: One assumption goes unnamed in the lecture: that only initial velocities are used, meaning the window where under 5-10% of substrate is consumed and product has not yet accumulated. That is what enforces assumption one experimentally. The catalysed reaction is not intrinsically irreversible, since an enzyme does not change Keq and catalyses both directions; rather, with [P] near zero at the start, the reverse flux is zero by construction.

extra.zh: 稳态假设 (Briggs-Haldane，d[ES]/dt = 0) 与原始的快速平衡假设 (Michaelis-Menten，E + S 与 ES 之间快速平衡) 是两回事：前者给出 Km = (k-1 + k2)/k1，后者给出 Km = k-1/k1 = Kd。只有当 k-1 >> k2（结合解离远快于催化）时两式才一致，Km 才真正等于解离常数、才可以直接当亲和力读。否则 Km 只是近似地反映亲和力，这一点是本章最常考的陷阱。
extra.en: The steady-state assumption (Briggs-Haldane, d[ES]/dt = 0) and the original rapid-equilibrium assumption (Michaelis-Menten, E + S in fast equilibrium with ES) are different things: the first gives Km = (k-1 + k2)/k1, the second gives Km = k-1/k1 = Kd. The two coincide only when k-1 >> k2, that is when binding and release are much faster than catalysis, and only then is Km truly a dissociation constant readable as affinity. Otherwise Km only approximates affinity, which is the most frequently examined trap in this chapter.

quiz.q_zh: 米氏推导中的稳态假设 (steady state)，其数学表述是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the mathematical statement of the steady-state assumption in the derivation?

options.zh: 底物的浓度不随反应时间发生变化
options.en: The concentration of the substrate does not change with time

options.zh: 全部的酶都以 ES 复合体形式存在
options.en: All of the enzyme present exists as the ES complex

options.zh: 结合与解离的两个速率常数彼此相等
options.en: The association and dissociation rate constants are equal

options.zh: ES 复合体的浓度不随时间发生变化
options.en: The ES complex concentration does not change with time

quiz.explain_zh: 稳态即 d[ES]/dt = 0，ES 的生成速率与消失速率相等，浓度维持不变。底物浓度必须持续下降，否则就没有净反应；全部酶变成 ES 是饱和的定义，只在 [S] >> Km 时接近成立，与稳态无关；两个速率常数相等是对常数值的限制，稳态限制的是浓度，不是常数。
quiz.explain_en: The steady state is d[ES]/dt = 0: ES is formed and consumed at equal rates so its concentration stays constant. Substrate must keep falling, otherwise there is no net reaction; all enzyme being ES is the definition of saturation, approached only when [S] >> Km and unrelated to the steady state; equal rate constants is a constraint on constants, whereas the steady state constrains a concentration.

quiz.q_zh: 推导中「E + P 回到 E + S 的逆反应可忽略」，在实验上靠什么来保证？
quiz.q_en: Experimentally, what guarantees that the reverse step from E + P back to E + S is negligible?

options.zh: 只取初速度区间，此时产物尚未积累
options.en: Taking only initial velocities, before any product has accumulated

options.zh: 让 ES 复合体的浓度先达到稳态水平
options.en: Letting the concentration of the ES complex reach a steady state

options.zh: 把反应体系的温度严格控制在 37 度
options.en: Holding the temperature of the reaction system strictly at 37 degrees

options.zh: 让底物的浓度远远大于酶的浓度
options.en: Keeping the substrate concentration far above the enzyme concentration

quiz.explain_zh: 酶不改变反应的平衡常数，正逆两个方向它都催化，所以「不可逆」不是酶的性质而是实验条件：只在 [P] 约等于 0 的初速度窗口取数据，逆向通量自然为零。底物远大于酶保证的是游离 [S] 约等于总 [S]；稳态说的是 [ES] 不变，与产物多少无关；温度只影响速率大小，不影响反应方向。
quiz.explain_en: An enzyme does not alter the equilibrium constant and catalyses both directions, so irreversibility is not a property of the enzyme but of the conditions: data are taken only in the initial-velocity window where [P] is essentially zero, making the reverse flux vanish. Substrate exceeding enzyme ensures free [S] equals total [S]; the steady state concerns [ES] and says nothing about product; temperature changes the magnitude of rates, not the direction of the reaction.

quiz.q_zh: 在什么条件下 Km 才真正等于 ES 复合体的解离常数 Kd？
quiz.q_en: Under what condition does Km truly equal the dissociation constant Kd of the ES complex?

options.zh: 底物浓度正好等于 Km 的数值
options.en: The substrate concentration is exactly equal to Km

options.zh: 催化步 k2 远远大于解离步 k-1
options.en: The catalytic step k2 is far faster than dissociation k-1

options.zh: 解离步 k-1 远远大于催化步 k2
options.en: Dissociation k-1 is far faster than the catalytic step k2

options.zh: 底物浓度远远大于酶的总浓度
options.en: The substrate concentration far exceeds the total enzyme

quiz.explain_zh: 稳态推导给出 Km = (k-1 + k2)/k1。只有当 k-1 >> k2 时 k2 可以略去，Km ≈ k-1/k1 = Kd，此时 Km 才能读作亲和力。反过来 k2 >> k-1 时 Km ≈ k2/k1，反映的是催化而非结合。底物与酶浓度的比值决定的是推导前提；[S] = Km 决定的是速率等于 1/2 Vmax，都与 Km 的物理含义无关。
quiz.explain_en: The steady-state derivation gives Km = (k-1 + k2)/k1. Only when k-1 >> k2 can k2 be dropped, leaving Km = k-1/k1 = Kd, and only then can Km be read as affinity. In the opposite case, k2 >> k-1, Km approaches k2/k1 and reports catalysis rather than binding. The substrate-to-enzyme ratio governs the validity of the derivation, and [S] = Km fixes the rate at half Vmax; neither bears on the physical meaning of Km.

title_zh: 三个假设的复述，与学生提问：毫秒级的极快反应怎么测
title_en: Recap of the three assumptions, and a student question on assaying millisecond reactions

points.zh: 老师承认米氏方程可以代换去推还没到 Vmax 时的酶活速度，但「并不一定是精准的」，因为还涉及很多其他因素。
points.en: The teacher concedes the equation can be rearranged to give rates short of Vmax, but 'not necessarily accurately', because many other factors come in.

points.zh: 复述假设一：enzyme + substrate 变成 enzyme + product 之后，那个 K4 常数可以忽略，即基本不可逆。
points.en: Recap of assumption one: after enzyme plus substrate becomes enzyme plus product, the K4 constant can be ignored, so the reaction is essentially irreversible.

points.zh: 复述假设二：ES 即酶和底物复合体，它的形成和消失达到稳态。
points.en: Recap of assumption two: ES, the enzyme-substrate complex, forms and disappears at a steady state.

points.zh: 学生的比喻「有点像氢键随时断裂随时形成」被再次确认。
points.en: The student's analogy of hydrogen bonds constantly breaking and re-forming is confirmed again.

points.zh: 老师把稳态的含义说成「整个酶活催化的反应都达到稳态了」，学生接「就是平衡了」，老师说 OK。
points.en: The teacher glosses the steady state as 'the whole catalysed reaction has reached steady state'; the student says 'so it is equilibrium', and the teacher agrees.

points.zh: 复述假设三：底物的浓度远远大于酶的浓度，老师说这时候测的就是 Vmax。
points.en: Recap of assumption three: substrate concentration far exceeds enzyme concentration, and the teacher says this is when Vmax is measured.

points.zh: 学生提问（自称 out of the topic）：有些酶促反应可能只要几毫秒，这种一般怎么测？
points.en: A student asks, flagging it as off topic, how one measures enzyme reactions that finish in a few milliseconds.

points.zh: 老师回答：这种基本只能定性，确认它有活性、能把什么转化成什么。
points.en: The teacher answers that such reactions can generally only be assessed qualitatively: confirming activity and what is converted into what.

points.zh: 老师认为几毫秒的反应定量不好定，要测它的 Vmax 基本不太可能，除非有一些特殊手段。
points.en: He considers millisecond reactions hard to quantify and measuring their Vmax essentially impossible, unless some special means exists.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 稳态 (steady state) 不等于平衡 (equilibrium)，课上把两个词当成同义词用了。稳态下 [ES] 不变，但体系仍有净通量：底物在持续被消耗、产物在持续生成、自由能在持续耗散，靠的是 [S] 远大于 [E] 所提供的储备。平衡则是净速率为零、正逆通量相等、自由能变为零、不再有任何净变化。一个活细胞是稳态，死细胞才是平衡。
extra.en: Steady state is not equilibrium, though the lecture uses the two words interchangeably. In a steady state [ES] is constant yet there is net flux: substrate is continuously consumed, product continuously formed and free energy continuously dissipated, sustained by the reservoir that [S] >> [E] provides. At equilibrium the net rate is zero, forward and reverse fluxes are equal, the free energy change is zero and nothing changes further. A living cell is at steady state; only a dead one is at equilibrium.

extra.zh: 毫秒级反应其实是可以定量的，只是要换仪器。stopped-flow 快速混合的死时间约 1 毫秒，之后连续监测荧光或吸光；rapid quench-flow 在毫秒后用酸或碱化学淬灭再取样分析；温度跳跃 (temperature jump) 等弛豫方法可以到微秒甚至纳秒。它们测的是 pre-steady-state（稳态建立之前的暴发相 burst phase），能拆出 k1、k-1、k2 这些单步常数，而稳态动力学只能给 kcat 和 Km 这样的组合参数。
extra.en: Millisecond reactions can in fact be quantified, but they need different instruments. Stopped-flow mixing has a dead time of about one millisecond and then follows fluorescence or absorbance continuously; rapid quench-flow chemically quenches the reaction with acid or base after a few milliseconds and analyses the sample; relaxation methods such as temperature jump reach microseconds or even nanoseconds. These probe the pre-steady state, the burst phase before the steady state is established, and resolve individual constants such as k1, k-1 and k2, whereas steady-state kinetics yields only composite parameters like kcat and Km.

extra.zh: 经典例子是 chymotrypsin 的 burst kinetics：用对硝基苯酯类底物时，最初出现一个化学计量的产物爆发（每个酶分子一次），随后转为慢的稳态速率。这直接证明了共价酰基-酶中间体的存在，并说明限速步是去酰基化而不是酰基化。这一类信息稳态动力学完全给不出来，必须做 pre-steady-state。
extra.en: The classic example is burst kinetics in chymotrypsin: with a p-nitrophenyl ester substrate an initial stoichiometric burst of product appears, one per enzyme molecule, followed by a slower steady-state rate. This directly demonstrates a covalent acyl-enzyme intermediate and shows that deacylation, not acylation, is rate-limiting. Steady-state kinetics cannot deliver this kind of information at all; pre-steady-state measurement is required.

extra.zh: ES 是基态的 Michaelis 复合体，不是过渡态；过渡态写作 ES‡。酶降低的是活化自由能 ΔG‡，也就是 ES 到 ES‡ 那一段；它对过渡态的亲和力远高于对底物的亲和力（可差 10 个数量级以上），这正是过渡态类似物能做成极强抑制剂的原理。Km 描述的只是 ES 的形成，与过渡态的稳定化没有直接关系。
extra.en: ES is the ground-state Michaelis complex, not the transition state, which is written ES double-dagger. What the enzyme lowers is the activation free energy, the gap from ES to ES double-dagger; its affinity for the transition state exceeds its affinity for the substrate by many orders of magnitude, which is exactly why transition-state analogues make extraordinarily potent inhibitors. Km describes only the formation of ES and has no direct bearing on transition-state stabilisation.

quiz.q_zh: 关于稳态 (steady state) 与平衡 (equilibrium)，下列哪一项正确？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about steady state versus equilibrium is correct?

options.zh: 稳态下 [ES] 不变但仍有净反应通量
options.en: In a steady state [ES] is constant but net flux continues

options.zh: 稳态要求正逆两个方向的速率常数相等
options.en: A steady state requires the forward and reverse rate constants to be equal

options.zh: 稳态就是整个反应体系达到了化学平衡
options.en: A steady state means the whole system has reached chemical equilibrium

options.zh: 平衡状态下底物仍然在被持续净消耗
options.en: At equilibrium the substrate is still being consumed on a net basis

quiz.explain_zh: 稳态是中间体浓度不变而通量不为零：底物在耗、产物在生、自由能在耗散。平衡则净速率为零、不再有净消耗，所以说平衡下底物仍被净消耗是自相矛盾的。稳态限制的是中间体的浓度，而不是速率常数的数值，两个速率常数相等既非必要也非充分。
quiz.explain_en: A steady state means the intermediate's concentration is constant while flux is non-zero: substrate is consumed, product formed and free energy dissipated. At equilibrium the net rate is zero and there is no net consumption, so saying substrate is still net consumed at equilibrium is self-contradictory. The steady state constrains the concentration of an intermediate, not the values of rate constants, and equal rate constants are neither necessary nor sufficient.

quiz.q_zh: 要定量测量几毫秒内完成的酶促单步反应，应该采用什么方法？
quiz.q_en: Which method allows quantitative measurement of a single enzymatic step finishing within milliseconds?

options.zh: 用平衡透析法测定底物与酶之间的结合常数
options.en: Determining the enzyme-substrate binding constant by equilibrium dialysis

options.zh: 在 96 孔板上每隔 30 秒读一个荧光终点
options.en: Reading a fluorescence endpoint every 30 seconds in a 96-well plate

options.zh: 用 stopped-flow 混合后连续监测信号
options.en: Mixing by stopped-flow and following the signal continuously

options.zh: 用变性 PAGE 电泳分离并定量反应产物
options.en: Separating and quantifying the reaction products by denaturing PAGE

quiz.explain_zh: stopped-flow 的死时间约 1 毫秒，混合后即可连续记录荧光或吸光的变化，正好覆盖这个时间尺度；rapid quench-flow 是它的取样版本。每 30 秒读一次的板式读数在毫秒尺度上只能看到反应早已结束；跑胶是终点法，手工操作达不到毫秒的时间分辨；平衡透析测的是热力学结合常数，根本不是速率测定。
quiz.explain_en: Stopped-flow has a dead time of about one millisecond and records fluorescence or absorbance continuously from the moment of mixing, exactly matching this timescale; rapid quench-flow is its sampling counterpart. A plate reader sampling every 30 seconds would see only a reaction that finished long ago; a gel is an endpoint method whose manual handling cannot reach millisecond resolution; equilibrium dialysis measures a thermodynamic binding constant and is not a rate measurement at all.

quiz.q_zh: 对 ES 复合体的正确描述是什么？
quiz.q_en: Which is a correct description of the ES complex?

options.zh: 酶与反应产物结合所形成的那个复合体
options.en: The complex formed between the enzyme and the reaction product

options.zh: 酶被底物共价修饰以后的那种失活形式
options.en: The inactivated form of the enzyme covalently modified by substrate

options.zh: 位于反应途径能量最高点的那个过渡态
options.en: The transition state, the highest point on the reaction path

options.zh: 底物结合后的基态 Michaelis 复合体
options.en: The ground-state Michaelis complex formed on binding

quiz.explain_zh: ES 是底物结合到活性位点后形成的基态复合体，位于能量曲线的一个低谷；能量最高点是过渡态 ES‡，酶降低的正是 ES 到 ES‡ 的这一段。酶与产物的复合体记作 EP，是催化之后的物种；被底物共价修饰而失活描述的是自杀性底物 (mechanism-based inhibitor)，不是正常催化循环里的 ES。
quiz.explain_en: ES is the ground-state complex formed when substrate binds the active site and sits in an energy well; the highest point is the transition state ES double-dagger, and what the enzyme lowers is precisely the gap from ES to it. The enzyme-product complex is written EP and comes after catalysis; covalent modification by substrate leading to inactivation describes a suicide or mechanism-based inhibitor, not the ES of a normal catalytic cycle.

title_zh: 插曲：毫秒级快反应怎么测，以及要不要会推导（含闲聊）
title_en: Interlude: measuring millisecond-fast reactions, and whether the derivation matters (part chat)

points.zh: 对几毫秒就完成的酶促反应，常规酶活测定基本只能做定性：证明这个蛋白有活性、能把某底物转化成某产物。
points.en: For enzyme reactions finishing in a few milliseconds, a routine activity assay can only be qualitative: it shows the protein is active and converts a given substrate into a given product.

points.zh: 讲者提到荧光法 fluorescence 和同位素法 isotope labelling 作为可能的快速检测手段。
points.en: The lecturer mentions fluorescence methods and isotope labelling as possible ways to follow fast reactions.

points.zh: 同位素法的原理：给底物换上同位素原子（他的例子是把水换成重水或超重水），再检测同位素跑到了哪个分子、哪个位置上。
points.en: The principle of isotope labelling: put an isotope into the substrate (his example is replacing water with heavy or super-heavy water), then detect which molecule and which position the isotope ends up in.

points.zh: 讲者明确说不确定这类仪器的灵敏度/时间分辨率能否到毫秒级，没有下结论。
points.en: He explicitly says he is not sure whether such instruments have millisecond time resolution, and does not draw a conclusion.

points.zh: 他自己做的蛋白酶 protease 反应以分钟计，大约 10 分钟才水解掉大量底物，所以可以定量地测 Vmax。
points.en: His own protease reaction runs on a minute timescale, taking about 10 minutes to hydrolyse a lot of substrate, so Vmax can be measured quantitatively.

points.zh: 接下来要补的不是三个假设的解释，而是米氏方程 Michaelis-Menten equation 本身的推导。
points.en: What comes next is not an explanation of the three assumptions but the derivation of the Michaelis-Menten equation itself.

points.zh: 他推测考官可能会追问推导过程，所以决定过一遍；这段关于出题人的评价属于课堂闲聊。
points.en: He suspects examiners may ask for the derivation, so he decides to go through it; his remarks about the examiners are classroom chat.

points.zh: 中间因为 WPS 卡住暂停了一小段，属于设备插曲，不含讲授内容。
points.en: A short pause follows because WPS froze - an equipment interruption with no lecture content.

extra.zh: 毫秒级反应的标准手段是快速混合技术：stopped-flow（停流，死时间约 1 ms）和 quenched-flow（淬流），配合 pre-steady-state / single-turnover 实验，可以直接看到 burst phase。同位素主要用于动力学同位素效应 KIE 和示踪，本身并不提高时间分辨率。
extra.en: The standard tools for millisecond kinetics are rapid-mixing methods: stopped-flow (dead time about 1 ms) and quenched-flow, used in pre-steady-state / single-turnover experiments where the burst phase is directly visible. Isotopes are mainly for kinetic isotope effects (KIE) and tracing; they do not by themselves improve time resolution.

extra.zh: 米氏方程推导的三个前提要能背出来：① 只测初速度 v0，忽略逆反应 E+P→ES；② 稳态假设 steady state，d[ES]/dt = 0；③ [S] 远大于酶总浓度 [E]t，使自由底物浓度约等于加入的总底物浓度。
extra.en: The three premises of the derivation should be memorised: (1) only the initial velocity v0 is measured, so the reverse step E+P→ES is ignored; (2) the steady-state assumption, d[ES]/dt = 0; (3) [S] is much greater than total enzyme [E]t, so free substrate is approximately the total substrate added.

extra.zh: 定性还是定量，界限不在于反应"快"，而在于能否在底物消耗小于 5–10% 的时间窗口内取到多个点。用低酶浓度可以把这个窗口拉长，所以 kcat 很大的酶同样能做稳态动力学。
extra.en: The line between qualitative and quantitative is not set by how fast the reaction is, but by whether several time points can be taken while less than 5-10% of the substrate is consumed. Lowering the enzyme concentration stretches that window, so even enzymes with a large kcat can be studied by steady-state kinetics.

quiz.q_zh: 按讲者的说法，对只需几毫秒完成的酶促反应，常规测定通常只能做到什么？
quiz.q_en: According to the lecturer, what can a routine assay usually achieve for an enzyme reaction that finishes in a few milliseconds?

options.zh: 只能定性确认酶有活性
options.en: Only confirm activity qualitatively

options.zh: 直接测出酶的分子量
options.en: Measure the enzyme's molecular mass

options.zh: 解析酶的三维结构
options.en: Resolve the enzyme's 3D structure

options.zh: 定量测出 Vmax 和 Km
options.en: Measure Vmax and Km quantitatively

quiz.explain_zh: 时间分辨率跟不上，就取不到反应初期的多个点，因此测不到可靠的 Vmax 和 Km，只能证明活性存在。测分子量和解析三维结构与酶活测定不是同一类实验，与反应快慢无关。
quiz.explain_en: Without the time resolution to take several early time points, neither Vmax nor Km can be obtained reliably, so only the existence of activity can be shown. Measuring molecular mass and resolving the 3D structure are different experiments altogether and have nothing to do with how fast the reaction is.

quiz.q_zh: 要在毫秒尺度上直接跟踪酶促反应，标准做法是哪一种？
quiz.q_en: Which approach is the standard way to follow an enzyme reaction on a millisecond timescale?

options.zh: 常规分光光度计比色
options.en: Standard cuvette spectrophotometry

options.zh: SDS-PAGE 跑胶定量
options.en: Quantifying bands on SDS-PAGE

options.zh: 延长孵育后取样测定
options.en: Sampling after a long incubation

options.zh: stopped-flow 快速混合
options.en: Stopped-flow rapid mixing

quiz.explain_zh: stopped-flow 的死时间约 1 ms，能看到稳态之前的过程。常规比色和延长孵育后取样的时间分辨率都在秒到分钟级；SDS-PAGE 跑胶属于终点测定，完全无法分辨毫秒尺度。
quiz.explain_en: Stopped-flow has a dead time of about 1 ms and can capture events before the steady state. Standard cuvette spectrophotometry and sampling after a long incubation both work on seconds-to-minutes; running an SDS-PAGE gel is an end-point measurement with no millisecond resolution at all.

title_zh: 推导第一步：不可逆假设、以 ES 为核心、稳态假设
title_en: First steps of the derivation: irreversibility, ES at the centre, and the steady state

points.zh: 假设一：把反应当作不可逆 irreversible，直接丢掉 E+P→ES 这一步（讲者称它的常数为 k4），否则推导会被严重干扰。
points.en: Assumption 1: treat the reaction as irreversible and drop the step E+P→ES (he calls its constant k4), which would otherwise clutter the derivation.

points.zh: 整个推导以 ES 复合物为核心，因为 ES 是连接 E+S 和 E+P 的桥梁，是一个中间物。
points.en: The whole derivation is built around the ES complex, because ES is the bridge linking E+S to E+P - an intermediate.

points.zh: 第一步写出的是 ES 随时间的变化率 d[ES]/dt，也就是 ES 在这一时刻的变化速率。
points.en: The first thing written down is the change of ES with time, d[ES]/dt, i.e. the rate at which ES changes at that instant.

points.zh: ES 只有一条生成途径：E + S 经 k1 生成 ES（逆向的那条已经被删掉了）。
points.en: ES has only one route of formation: E + S combining via k1 (the reverse route has already been deleted).

points.zh: ES 有两条消失途径：经 k2 解离回 E + S，经 k3 转化为 E + P。
points.en: ES has two routes of disappearance: dissociating back to E + S via k2, and turning into E + P via k3.

points.zh: 假设二（稳态 steady state）：ES 的形成速率等于它的分解速率，于是把这两个表达式令为相等。
points.en: Assumption 2 (steady state): the rate of ES formation equals the rate of its breakdown, so the two expressions are set equal.

points.zh: 形成速率只含 k1，分解速率含 k2 和 k3；令二者相等后，通式里同时出现 k1、k2、k3 三个常数。
points.en: The formation rate contains only k1, the breakdown rate contains k2 and k3; once they are set equal, all three constants k1, k2 and k3 appear in the same expression.

points.zh: 讲者纠正学生的误解：三个常数同时出现在一个式子里，并不意味着 k1 = k2 = k3，它们互不相等。
points.en: He corrects a student's misunderstanding: the three constants appearing in one equation does not mean k1 = k2 = k3; they are all different.

extra.zh: 讲者全程把"微分 differentiation / 导数 derivative"说成"微积分 calculus"。d[ES]/dt 是微分（导数），不是微积分；他解释的含义——某一时刻的瞬时变化率——是对的，只是名称叫错了。
extra.en: Throughout, the lecturer says "calculus" where he means "differentiation" or "the derivative". d[ES]/dt is a derivative, not calculus as such; the meaning he gives - the instantaneous rate of change at a given moment - is correct, only the name is wrong.

extra.zh: ES 是基态的米氏复合物 Michaelis complex，不是过渡态 transition state。过渡态写作 ES‡，处在能量最高点，寿命只有一次键振动的量级（约 10⁻¹³ s）。酶的催化力来自对 ES‡ 的稳定，而不是对 ES 的稳定——过度稳定 ES 反而会拉高活化能。
extra.en: ES is the ground-state Michaelis complex, not the transition state. The transition state is written ES‡, sits at the energy maximum, and lasts about one bond vibration (roughly 10⁻¹³ s). Catalytic power comes from stabilising ES‡, not ES - over-stabilising ES actually raises the activation barrier.

extra.zh: "不可逆"实际上是初速度 initial velocity 条件：只在 [P] 约等于 0 的最初阶段测 v0，逆反应才可忽略。这不是说酶催化的化学反应本身不可逆——酶不改变平衡，只加快到达平衡的速度。
extra.en: "Irreversible" is really the initial-velocity condition: the reverse reaction is negligible only in the earliest phase, while [P] is still essentially zero. It does not mean the chemical reaction itself is irreversible - an enzyme does not shift the equilibrium, it only speeds up reaching it.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 教材通常写 E + S ⇌(k1 / k₋1) ES →(k2) E + P。讲者的 k2 对应教材的 k₋1（解离），他的 k3 对应教材的 k2（即 kcat），他丢掉的"k4"就是 E+P→ES 的 k₋2。看不同书时要先核对编号。
extra.en: Textbooks normally write E + S ⇌(k1 / k₋1) ES →(k2) E + P. His k2 is the textbook k₋1 (dissociation), his k3 is the textbook k2 (i.e. kcat), and the "k4" he drops is k₋2 for E+P→ES. Always check the numbering when moving between sources.

quiz.q_zh: 米氏方程推导中的稳态假设 steady-state assumption 说的是什么？
quiz.q_en: What does the steady-state assumption in the Michaelis-Menten derivation state?

options.zh: [E] 与 [S] 的浓度始终相等
options.en: [E] and [S] are always equal in amount

options.zh: 产物的生成速率等于零
options.en: The rate of product formation is zero

options.zh: [S] 在反应中保持恒定
options.en: [S] stays constant during the reaction

options.zh: ES 的生成速率等于分解速率
options.en: ES forms as fast as it breaks down

quiz.explain_zh: 稳态说的是中间物 ES 的浓度不随时间变化，即 d[ES]/dt = 0。底物浓度恒定只是初速度阶段的近似，不是稳态假设本身；酶与底物浓度相等违背 [S] 远大于 [E] 的前提；产物生成速率为零则等于说反应根本没在进行。
quiz.explain_en: The steady state says the concentration of the intermediate ES does not change with time, i.e. d[ES]/dt = 0. Constant [S] is only an approximation valid during the initial phase, not the assumption itself; equal enzyme and substrate concentrations contradict the premise that [S] far exceeds [E]; and a zero rate of product formation would mean no reaction at all.

quiz.q_zh: 在米氏机制中，ES 的身份是什么？
quiz.q_en: In the Michaelis-Menten mechanism, what is ES?

options.zh: 反应的最终产物 E+P
options.en: The final product complex E+P

options.zh: 反应的过渡态 ES‡
options.en: The transition state ES‡

options.zh: 酶的变构调节位点
options.en: An allosteric regulatory site

options.zh: 基态的米氏复合物
options.en: The ground-state Michaelis complex

quiz.explain_zh: ES 是能量谷底、可以分离表征的基态复合物；过渡态 ES‡ 是能量最高点，寿命约一次键振动，无法分离。变构位点是调节分子的结合处，不是催化中间物；E+P 是反应结束后的产物状态，不是中间物。
quiz.explain_en: ES sits in an energy well and is a ground-state complex that can be characterised; the transition state ES‡ sits at the energy maximum, lasts about one bond vibration and cannot be isolated. An allosteric site is where a regulator binds, not a catalytic intermediate, and E+P is the state after the reaction, not an intermediate.

quiz.q_zh: 推导一开始被舍弃的是哪一步反应？
quiz.q_en: Which step is discarded at the start of the derivation?

options.zh: ES → E + P 的催化
options.en: The catalytic step ES → E + P

options.zh: E + P → ES 的逆反应
options.en: The reverse step E + P → ES

options.zh: E + S → ES 的正反应
options.en: The forward step E + S → ES

options.zh: ES → E + S 的解离
options.en: The dissociation ES → E + S

quiz.explain_zh: 舍弃的是产物重新结合成 ES 的那一步，因为初速度阶段 [P] 约等于 0。E+S→ES 是 ES 唯一的生成途径，ES→E+S 的解离和 ES→E+P 的催化是构成 Km 的两个消耗途径，三者都必须保留。
quiz.explain_en: What is dropped is product re-binding to form ES, because [P] is essentially zero during the initial phase. E + S → ES is the only route that makes ES, while dissociation back to E + S and catalysis to E + P are the two consumption routes that make up Km; all three must be kept.

title_zh: 引入 Km 和 Vmax：把测不到的 [E] 和 [ES] 消掉
title_en: Introducing Km and Vmax to eliminate the unmeasurable [E] and [ES]

points.zh: 为了让式子尽可能简洁，引入 Km，定义为 Km = (k2 + k3)/k1。
points.en: To simplify the expression, Km is introduced, defined as Km = (k2 + k3)/k1.

points.zh: 讲者给的读法：k2 和 k3 都是 ES 的消耗速率常数，k1 是生成，所以 Km 是 ES 的消耗速率除以生成速率。
points.en: His reading of it: k2 and k3 are both rate constants for consuming ES and k1 is the one that makes it, so Km is the rate of ES consumption divided by the rate of its formation.

points.zh: 用 Km 把 k1、k2、k3 三个常数替换掉之后，式子里仍然留着游离酶 [E] 和复合物 [ES]。
points.en: After k1, k2 and k3 have been replaced by Km, the equation still contains free enzyme [E] and complex [ES].

points.zh: 实验上很难测出某一时刻有多少酶结合了底物、多少没结合，所以这两项必须消掉。
points.en: Experimentally it is very hard to tell how much enzyme has substrate bound at a given instant and how much does not, so both terms must be eliminated.

points.zh: 讲者把没结合底物的酶叫 apo 状态、结合了底物的叫 holo 状态，说这两个状态都基本测不到。
points.en: He calls enzyme without substrate the apo state and enzyme with substrate the holo state, and says neither can really be measured.

points.zh: 第三个假设：当底物浓度远大于酶浓度时，测到的速率就是 Vmax。
points.en: Assumption 3: when the substrate concentration far exceeds the enzyme concentration, the measured rate is Vmax.

points.zh: Vmax 可以写成 k3 × [ES]，也就是由 ES → E + P 这一真正产生酶活的步骤决定。
points.en: Vmax can be written as k3 x [ES], i.e. it is set by the step ES → E + P that actually generates the measured activity.

points.zh: 用 Vmax 替换掉所有的 [E] 和 [ES] 之后，方程里 Vmax 和 Km 都是常数，唯一的变量只剩 [S]，而底物浓度恰好是好测的。
points.en: Once Vmax has absorbed every [E] and [ES] term, both Vmax and Km in the equation are constants and the only variable left is [S] - which happens to be the one thing that is easy to measure.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 使 v 趋近 Vmax 的条件是 [S] 远大于 Km（酶被底物饱和），不是 [S] 远大于 [E]。[S] ≫ [E] 的作用是另一件事：保证自由底物浓度约等于加入的总浓度，使 [S] 可以当常数处理。因为多数酶的 Km 本来就远大于实验用的 [E]t，两个条件常常同时成立，但考试问的是 [S] 与 Km 的相对大小。
extra.en: What drives v towards Vmax is [S] >> Km (the enzyme being saturated), not [S] >> [E]. The condition [S] >> [E] does something else: it keeps free substrate approximately equal to the total added, so [S] can be treated as constant. Since Km is usually far above the [E]t used in an assay, both hold at once in practice - but the exam asks about [S] relative to Km.

extra.zh: 严格写法是 Vmax = kcat·[E]t，即所有酶都以 ES 形式存在时的速率，所以 Vmax 与酶总浓度成正比，换一个酶浓度 Vmax 就变。kcat = Vmax/[E]t 是转换数 turnover number，单位 s⁻¹，与酶浓度无关。
extra.en: Written properly, Vmax = kcat·[E]t, the rate when all the enzyme is present as ES; Vmax is therefore proportional to total enzyme and changes whenever the enzyme concentration changes. kcat = Vmax/[E]t is the turnover number, in s⁻¹, and is independent of enzyme concentration.

extra.zh: apo / holo 在标准用法里指是否结合辅因子 cofactor（apoenzyme 无辅因子，holoenzyme 含辅因子），不是指是否结合底物。讲者这里是借用这两个词描述游离酶与 ES，理解意思即可，答题时不要这样写。
extra.en: In standard usage apo/holo refer to cofactor binding (apoenzyme lacks its cofactor, holoenzyme has it), not to substrate binding. He is borrowing the words for free enzyme versus ES; understand the intent, but do not write it this way in an exam.

extra.zh: 消去游离酶用的是酶的质量守恒 [E]t = [E] + [ES]，把 [E] 换成 [E]t − [ES]，再解出 [ES]。这一步课上一带而过，却是整个推导的关键代数动作。
extra.en: Free enzyme is eliminated using enzyme conservation, [E]t = [E] + [ES]: substitute [E] = [E]t - [ES] and solve for [ES]. The lecture passes over this quickly, yet it is the key algebraic move of the whole derivation.

quiz.q_zh: 在米氏机制中，Km 的动力学定义是（用教材编号 E+S ⇌ k1/k₋1 ES →k2 E+P）：
quiz.q_en: With textbook numbering (E+S ⇌ k1/k₋1 ES →k2 E+P), the kinetic definition of Km is:
quiz.explain_zh: 分子是 ES 的两条消耗途径之和（解离 k₋1 加催化 k2），分母是唯一的生成途径 k1，正是讲者说的"消耗除以生成"。把 k1 放到分子上的写法是它的倒数，量纲变成 M⁻¹；用 k₋1 或 k2 作分母都不对应任何一条生成途径。
quiz.explain_en: The numerator sums the two ways ES is consumed (dissociation k₋1 plus catalysis k2) and the denominator is the single route that forms it, k1 - exactly the lecturer's "consumption over formation". Putting k1 in the numerator gives the reciprocal, with units of M⁻¹, and using k₋1 or k2 as the denominator matches no formation route at all.

quiz.q_zh: Vmax 与酶的总浓度 [E]t 是什么关系？
quiz.q_en: How does Vmax relate to the total enzyme concentration [E]t?

options.zh: 只由 Km 的数值决定
options.en: Set entirely by the value of Km

options.zh: 与酶浓度无关，是特征常数
options.en: Independent of enzyme concentration

options.zh: 与酶总浓度成正比
options.en: Proportional to total enzyme

options.zh: 与酶总浓度成反比
options.en: Inversely related to enzyme

quiz.explain_zh: Vmax = kcat·[E]t，酶加倍则 Vmax 加倍。与酶浓度无关的特征常数是 Km 和 kcat，不是 Vmax；反比关系没有任何依据；Km 决定的是达到半饱和所需的底物浓度，不决定 Vmax 的高低。
quiz.explain_en: Vmax = kcat·[E]t, so doubling the enzyme doubles Vmax. The quantities independent of enzyme concentration are Km and kcat, not Vmax; an inverse relation has no basis; and Km sets the substrate concentration needed for half-saturation, not the height of Vmax.

quiz.q_zh: 反应速率接近 Vmax 的真正条件是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the real condition for the rate to approach Vmax?

options.zh: [E] 远大于 [S]
options.en: [E] is far above [S]

options.zh: [S] 远小于 Km
options.en: [S] is far below Km

options.zh: [S] 远大于 [E]
options.en: [S] is far above [E]

options.zh: [S] 远大于 Km
options.en: [S] is far above Km

quiz.explain_zh: 只有底物浓度远高于 Km 时酶才被饱和，速率才逼近 Vmax。"[S] 远大于 [E]"是另一个前提，它保证自由底物约等于总底物，本身并不意味着饱和；"[S] 远小于 Km"给出的是一级反应区；"[E] 远大于 [S]"则连稳态推导的前提都不成立。
quiz.explain_en: Only when substrate is far above Km is the enzyme saturated and the rate close to Vmax. "[S] far above [E]" is a different premise - it keeps free substrate equal to total substrate but does not by itself mean saturation; "[S] far below Km" defines the first-order region; and "[E] far above [S]" breaks the premises of the steady-state derivation altogether.

title_zh: 情况一：[S] 远小于 Km 时的一级反应，以及 Km 作为酶的特征常数
title_en: Case 1: first-order kinetics when [S] << Km, and Km as a characteristic constant of the enzyme

points.zh: 讲者强调米氏方程理论上能预测酶促反应任意阶段、任意底物浓度下的速率，所以接下来分情况讨论。
points.en: He stresses that the Michaelis-Menten equation can in principle predict the rate at any stage and any substrate concentration, so the discussion is split into cases.

points.zh: 情况一是底物浓度远小于 Km；Km 是一个常数（等于 (k2+k3)/k1），所以这是拿变量 [S] 和一个常数比大小。
points.en: Case 1 is [S] far below Km; since Km is a constant (equal to (k2+k3)/k1), this compares the variable [S] against a fixed number.

points.zh: 数学上分母 Km + [S] 里的 [S] 占比太小，可以直接消掉，分母近似为 Km。
points.en: Mathematically [S] contributes so little to the denominator Km + [S] that it can be dropped, leaving the denominator as Km.

points.zh: 于是方程变成 v = (Vmax/Km)·[S]，即一个常数乘以唯一的变量 [S]。
points.en: The equation then becomes v = (Vmax/Km)·[S], a constant multiplied by the single variable [S].

points.zh: Vmax 和 Km 都是常数，速率与底物浓度成正比，这就是一级反应 first-order reaction。
points.en: Vmax and Km are both constants, so the rate is proportional to substrate concentration - a first-order reaction.

points.zh: 生物学解读：此时底物远未饱和酶，"给一点底物就反应一点，再给一点就再反应一点"。
points.en: Biological reading: the enzyme is far from saturated, so "give it a bit of substrate and it reacts a bit; give it more and it reacts more".

points.zh: Km 后来被赋予生物学含义：科学家把它看作一个特征常数 characteristic constant，一种酶只有一个 Km，用来反映这个酶的特性。
points.en: Km was later given a biological meaning: it is treated as a characteristic constant, one Km per enzyme, reflecting a property of that enzyme.

points.zh: Km 只与酶的性质和反应条件有关，与酶的浓度绝对无关——这一点讲者说得很重。
points.en: Km depends only on the nature of the enzyme and the reaction conditions, and is absolutely independent of enzyme concentration - a point he emphasises heavily.

extra.zh: 一级 first-order 与零级 zero-order 的分界由 [S] 相对于 Km 决定，与"底物分子数远多于酶分子数"没有关系。在 [S] ≪ Km 的一级区里，底物分子数通常已经远多于酶分子数（因为 Km 一般远大于 [E]t），反应照样是一级。
extra.en: The boundary between first-order and zero-order kinetics is set by [S] relative to Km, not by substrate molecules outnumbering enzyme molecules. In the first-order region where [S] << Km, substrate already outnumbers enzyme by far (Km is normally far above [E]t) and the reaction is still first-order.

extra.zh: [S] ≪ Km 时 v = (kcat/Km)·[E]t·[S]。kcat/Km 是特异性常数 specificity constant，单位 M⁻¹s⁻¹，是比较不同底物优劣的正确指标；它的上限受扩散控制，约 10⁸–10⁹ M⁻¹s⁻¹，达到这个量级的酶被称为"催化完美"catalytic perfection。
extra.en: When [S] << Km, v = (kcat/Km)·[E]t·[S]. kcat/Km is the specificity constant, in M⁻¹s⁻¹, and is the correct figure for ranking substrates; its ceiling is set by diffusion at roughly 10⁸-10⁹ M⁻¹s⁻¹, and enzymes reaching it are said to have achieved catalytic perfection.

extra.zh: "一种酶只有一个 Km"必须补上限定：对给定底物、给定条件。同一个酶对不同底物有不同的 Km，而且 Km 随 pH、温度、离子强度变化——这正好也是"与反应条件有关"的含义。
extra.en: "One Km per enzyme" needs a qualifier: per substrate and per set of conditions. The same enzyme has different Km values for different substrates, and Km shifts with pH, temperature and ionic strength - which is exactly what "depends on the reaction conditions" means.

quiz.q_zh: 当 [S] 远小于 Km 时，米氏方程简化成什么形式？
quiz.q_en: When [S] is far below Km, what does the Michaelis-Menten equation reduce to?

options.zh: v = Vmax·Km/[S]
options.en: v = Vmax·Km/[S]

options.zh: v = Vmax·[S]²/Km
options.en: v = Vmax·[S]²/Km

options.zh: v = (Km/Vmax)·[S]
options.en: v = (Km/Vmax)·[S]

options.zh: v = (Vmax/Km)·[S]
options.en: v = (Vmax/Km)·[S]

quiz.explain_zh: 分母里的 [S] 相对 Km 可忽略，剩下 Vmax·[S]/Km，是一条斜率为 Vmax/Km 的直线。把两个常数位置对调的 (Km/Vmax)·[S] 斜率取成了倒数；Vmax·Km/[S] 会随底物增加而下降，与实测的双曲线趋势相反；含 [S]² 的形式属于二级反应，单底物米氏机制中不会出现。
quiz.explain_en: [S] in the denominator is negligible next to Km, leaving Vmax·[S]/Km, a straight line of slope Vmax/Km. Swapping the two constants to give (Km/Vmax)·[S] inverts that slope; Vmax·Km/[S] would fall as substrate rises, the opposite of the observed hyperbola; and a form containing [S]² describes second-order kinetics, which never arises in a single-substrate Michaelis-Menten mechanism.

quiz.q_zh: 决定一个酶促反应处于一级还是零级动力学的，是下面哪一项？
quiz.q_en: What determines whether an enzyme reaction is in the first-order or the zero-order regime?

options.zh: [S] 与 Km 的相对大小
options.en: How [S] compares with the Km

options.zh: 底物分子数是否多于酶分子数
options.en: Whether substrate outnumbers enzyme

options.zh: 酶的浓度是否已经足够高
options.en: Whether enzyme concentration is high

options.zh: 反应时间是否足够长
options.en: Whether the reaction has run long

quiz.explain_zh: 只有 [S] 与 Km 的比值决定酶被饱和的程度。底物分子数多于酶分子数在几乎所有酶活测定里都成立，包括 [S] ≪ Km 的一级区，因此不能作为判据；酶浓度只改变 Vmax 的高低，不改变反应级数；延长时间只会消耗底物，反而把反应推回一级区。
quiz.explain_en: Only the ratio of [S] to Km sets how saturated the enzyme is. Substrate outnumbering enzyme is true in essentially every assay, including the first-order region where [S] << Km, so it cannot be the criterion; enzyme concentration only scales Vmax without changing the reaction order; and running longer merely consumes substrate, pushing the reaction back towards first-order.

quiz.q_zh: 把酶的浓度提高一倍，Km 会怎样变化？
quiz.q_en: If the enzyme concentration is doubled, what happens to Km?

options.zh: 先升后降
options.en: It rises then falls

options.zh: 保持不变
options.en: It stays unchanged

options.zh: 升高一倍
options.en: It doubles

options.zh: 降低一半
options.en: It halves

quiz.explain_zh: Km 由 k1、k₋1、k2 三个速率常数组成，只与酶本身的性质和反应条件（pH、温度）有关，与酶浓度无关；随酶浓度成倍变化的是 Vmax。升高、降低、先升后降这三种说法都是把 Vmax 的行为错安到 Km 上。
quiz.explain_en: Km is built from the rate constants k1, k₋1 and k2 and depends only on the enzyme itself and the conditions (pH, temperature), never on how much enzyme is present; the quantity that scales with enzyme concentration is Vmax. Doubling, halving or a rise-then-fall all misattribute the behaviour of Vmax to Km.

title_zh: pKa 的插问，以及 Km 与亲和力的关系（课上讲反了）
title_en: A question about pKa, and Km versus affinity (stated backwards in the lecture)

points.zh: 学生插问：为什么 pKa 可以有好几个，而一个酶只有一个 Km。
points.en: A student interrupts: why can there be several pKa values while an enzyme has only one Km?

points.zh: 讲者用磷酸 H3PO4 举例：它可以分几步解离，每一步对应一个 Ka，所以有多个 pKa。
points.en: He answers with phosphoric acid, H3PO4: it ionises in several steps, each with its own Ka, hence several pKa values.

points.zh: 他说 pKa 是化学上的概念，与 Km 离得比较远；酶动力学这里只考虑 ES 生成产物这一段，所以只有一个 Km。
points.en: He calls pKa a chemistry concept fairly remote from Km; here only the ES-to-product step is considered, so there is just one Km.

points.zh: Km 的第二个生物学意义：可以用来判断某个酶与某个底物之间的亲和力 affinity。
points.en: Second biological meaning of Km: it can be used to judge the affinity between an enzyme and its substrate.

points.zh: 讲者的原话是：Km 越大代表酶和底物越容易接近、越容易结合到一起，Km 越小代表适配性没那么高——这个方向讲反了，见下面的口误卡。
points.en: His words: a larger Km means the enzyme and substrate come together more readily, a smaller Km means they fit less well - this is backwards; see the misstatement card below.

points.zh: 回到情况一的生物学解读：[S] 远小于 Km，意思是给的底物浓度还远没到酶与底物"最合适"的浓度。
points.en: Back to case 1: [S] << Km means the substrate supplied is nowhere near the concentration at which enzyme and substrate are best matched.

points.zh: 此时底物远未饱和这个酶，"酶完全没被喂饱"，加多少底物就反应多少，速率与 [S] 成正比。
points.en: At that point the enzyme is nowhere near saturated - "not fed full at all" - so it reacts in proportion to whatever substrate is added.

points.zh: 讲者强调这一段结论与前面感性的描述完全一致，只是用米氏方程从数学角度重新推了一遍。
points.en: He stresses that this conclusion matches the intuitive picture given earlier; the Michaelis-Menten equation simply re-derives it mathematically.

extra.zh: 课上说"Km 越大，酶与底物的亲和力越高"，方向反了，而且这一段之后没有更正。正确关系是反比：Km 是达到 ½Vmax 所需的底物浓度，Km 越大说明要更多底物才能达到半最大速度，表观亲和力越低；Km 越小亲和力越高。这是本章最常考的一点。
extra.en: The lecture says "the larger the Km, the higher the affinity" - the relation is backwards, and no correction follows in this stretch. The true relation is inverse: Km is the substrate concentration giving ½Vmax, so a larger Km means more substrate is needed to reach half-maximal velocity and the apparent affinity is lower; a smaller Km means higher affinity. This is the single most examinable point in the topic.
